title: The Day Maggie Walker's Bank Took 280 Deposits, One of 31 Cents
conflicts: First-day takings: NPS gives 280 deposits totalling over $8,000 plus $1,247 of stock, $9,340.44 in all; American Heritage and American Banker give about $8,000 in deposits; 'over $9,000' elsewhere is the combined figure. The story gives both and labels them. The 1930 merger joined two other banks (Encyclopedia Virginia, American Banker) or three (American Heritage); the story uses two. Speech wording differs slightly ('moneys' in NPS and Encyclopedia Virginia, 'money' in American Heritage); the story quotes the NPS wording.
notes: The repeat screen flagged several bank and trust editions as same-company because of shared words ('bank', 'trust') but let it through. Quote stance: complicates (Tagore on accumulation as separation).
